name: Jean-Pierre Dubois
bio:
Jean-Pierre's motorsport journey began in the karting scene of Quebec, where his meticulous approach to tuning engines quickly gained attention. He transitioned to Formula Ford, demonstrating an aptitude for strategy and car setup. After a brief stint as a driver, Jean-Pierre found his true calling in team management, first with smaller outfits before rising through the ranks.

His appointment as Team Principal at Stake Sauber is the culmination of years of dedication. Jean-Pierre emphasizes clear communication and data-driven decision-making. He's known for his ability to identify and nurture young talent, fostering a supportive and collaborative environment within the team. His pragmatic approach is evident in his focus on sustainable growth and long-term success.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight receding hairline.
physical.description: Jean-Pierre has a thoughtful face with a strong jawline and a perpetually serious expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with handwritten notes.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on having a precisely measured cup of espresso at 10:00 AM sharp every day.
